title: console: a record-button flow whose write step dropped a read-only field shows a warning toast naming the fields (console half of #32861)
body:
domain:server#8 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwqTK71kjQzHae8T5J

Part of #32861
Blocked-by: #33007

Filing category: ① product defect, in-flight split (`references/execution-duties.md` in-scope sub-issue; priority inherited from #32861, p1). The server half is PR #33007 (`Part of #32861`); this card carries the card's Work 2, the console toast, and #32861 closes when this lands.

## 维护者速读

员工点按钮启动流程，流程想写的字段是只读的，写入被丢掉、按钮却答「成功」，员工什么都看不到。PR #33007 让流程的回答里带上「哪些字段没写进去、为什么」；这张卡让控制台把它弹成黄色警告，显示字段的中文名。

## Business reason

The #32666 case: a member clicks 「提交审批」, the flow's `update_record` step writes `status`, which is `readonly: true`; the write is dropped, the run succeeds, the record stays 「草稿」, and the console says nothing. After PR #33007 the flow-action answer carries `droppedFields` (`DroppedFieldsEvent`: object, fields, reason; omit-when-empty) on REST and MCP. Nothing in the console reads it yet.

## Expected

A person who starts a flow from a record action (and from a screen flow's resume) sees a warning toast in their locale when the answer carries `droppedFields`: the step ran, these fields (by label) were not written because they are read-only. No toast when the answer carries none. The existing `detail.writeStripped*` wording fits it.

## What the server half measured (PR #33007, Acceptance notes)

1. The wire parse of a `droppedFields` entry (`isWireDroppedFieldsEntry`, `asDroppedFieldsNotice`, the skew arm for an unknown `reason`) is private to `ui/packages/data-objectstack`. The console's flow launch (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/flowLaunch.ts`) does not go through the adapter: export the parser, ⛔ no second copy.
2. `writeWarningToast.emitWriteWarning` needs the adapter (field labels), which neither launch host (`hooks/useConsoleActionRuntime.tsx`, `views/RecordDetailView.tsx`) holds today.
3. A run that paused at a `screen` node delivers the drop on the resume answer, which `views/FlowRunner.tsx` reads: a third reader.
4. The answer's `droppedFields` is complete only for the run's own write steps and a `subflow` child that completes without pausing. A `map` item's run and a `subflow` child that paused and resumed do not roll up yet (#33019, server lane). Until #33019 lands, the toast reads a present member as a drop, and ⛔ never reads an absent member as "nothing was dropped" for those shapes (contract review of PR #33007, record 6843734657, S1).

## Work

1. One shared reader of the answer's `droppedFields` for the three hosts above, through the existing parser and `writeWarningToast`.
2. Pins: the #32666 shape (readonly `status`, flow behind a record action) yields the toast on the click with the field label; a clean click yields none; the resume path yields it. Ablate and show red.
3. Declarations per AGENTS.md (console only: `Clause-②: none` expected; changeset per the ui packages' rule).

Reader: `domain:ui` lane, once PR #33007 merges.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue droppedFields toast flow` → #32861 (parent) only.
